center_north.source: Triglav strip centre north (-24 m) plus twice the 80 m circuit radius and twice the 12 m strip width; the Stik pilot's route factors.

center_east.source: Copied from the normalized Triglav strip centre_east.

radius.source: Maximum of 0.8 times the 100 m strip length and 4.0 times its 12 m width, from the Stik pilot's route factors.

base_agl.source: Above the pilot's ground. The surveyed meadow under the circuit lies 1.0 to 7.4 m above the pilot, so the Club field's 35 m would sit inside the controller's 30 m terrain-recovery band; 45 m keeps at least 37.6 m. Passed the Triglav calm and gentle-practice 120 s matrix.

slot_agl_step.source: The Club field slot spacing; passed the Triglav 1-3 aircraft matrix.

duration_s.source: Six Triglav pilot-matrix scenarios, each completing 28,800 physics ticks at 240 Hz, in the field's standard air at 849.7 m.

min_agl.source: Minimum local terrain clearance across the six Triglav pilot-matrix scenarios (AFC-23-R1).

max_agl.source: Maximum local terrain clearance across the six Triglav pilot-matrix scenarios (AFC-23-R1); the top slot spawns 85 m above the local ground, up to 4.6 m above the pilot, then settles onto its band.

min_tas.source: Minimum TAS across the six Triglav pilot-matrix scenarios (AFC-23-R1).

max_tas.source: Maximum TAS across the six Triglav pilot-matrix scenarios (AFC-23-R1).

max_radial_error.source: Maximum absolute radial error across the six Triglav pilot-matrix scenarios (AFC-23-R1).

min_player_separation.source: Minimum player-to-companion center separation across the six Triglav pilot-matrix scenarios (AFC-23-R1).

min_pair_separation.source: Minimum companion-to-companion center separation in the tested Triglav multi-aircraft scenarios.
